content: For self-hosted services that return 502 via public IP:port but work on local loopback and LAN, the prioritized reusable troubleshooting workflow is: 1) Verify the public domain resolves to the actual public IP (not a CDN/edge node like Cloudflare) to rule out edge-level 502s, 2) Check router DNAT configuration for the target port to confirm correct internal backend routing, 3) Validate reverse proxy/port forwarding mappings exist for the target public port.
